## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run licenses:check`
- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] Relevant behavior tested on the target operating system

## Privacy, security, and release impact

- [ ] No secrets, personal paths, music files, or generated artifacts are included
- [ ] New network behavior and stored data are documented
- [ ] New dependencies use reviewed, GPL-compatible OSI licenses
- [ ] Packaging, workflow, lockfile, or signing-policy changes received explicit maintainer attention

## Screenshots or logs

Attach sanitized evidence when it helps reviewers. Remove usernames, local paths, NAS names, IP addresses, and track-library details.
